Trace terms effective September 22, 2026: These terms apply to new Trace orders placed on or after this date. Terms supplied with earlier orders remain unchanged.

Trace custom orders, cancellation and response deadlines

Trace is custom-made and is not eligible for change-of-mind returns. This does not exclude remedies for damaged or defective items under our refund policy. You may cancel for a full refund before giving written approval of your proof. Written approval authorizes production, so cancellation after approval but before production is at our discretion. Once production starts, the order cannot be canceled. Changes after approval may be considered at our discretion and must be accepted by us before they take effect.

Complete intake within 48 hours after receiving your order confirmation and intake instructions. Respond to each proof within 48 hours after it is sent. Missing or unclear details require clarification and keep production on hold. We send a reminder after 48 hours and a final reminder on day 7. If we receive no response for 10 calendar days after the relevant intake request or proof message, we cancel the unapproved order and issue a full refund. A reply requiring clarification is not treated as silence. No response is not approval.

Report shipping damage within 7 calendar days after delivery to support@teklostudio.com, with your order number and photos of the item and packaging. This shipping-damage reporting window does not remove the remedies for defective items described in our refund policy.

General returns

We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase from Teklo Studio. If for any reason you are not happy with your order, we offer a 14-day return policy to ensure your satisfaction.

Conditions for Returns:

  1. Eligibility: Items must be returned within 14 days of the delivery date.
  2. Original Condition: Products must be unused, undamaged, and in their original packaging.
  3. Proof of Purchase: A receipt or proof of purchase is required for all returns.
  4. Non-Returnable Items: Certain items, such as custom-made products or digital downloads, are non-returnable. These will be clearly marked on the product page.

How to Initiate a Return:

  1. Contact Us: Email our customer support team at support@teklostudio.com with your order number and reason for the return.
  2. Approval: Once your return is approved, we will provide you with the return address and instructions.
  3. Shipping: You are responsible for the return shipping costs. We recommend using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance.
  4. Refund Process: Once we receive your returned item and inspect it, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.
  5. Refund Timeline: If approved, your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your original method of payment within 7-10 business days.

Additional Information:

  • Exchanges: If you need to exchange an item, please contact us. Exchanges are subject to product availability.
  • Damaged or Defective Items: If your item arrives damaged or defective, please contact us immediately with photos of the damage. We will arrange for a replacement or refund at no additional cost to you.

If you have any questions about our return policy, please don't hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Your satisfaction is our top priority!

Trace terms effective September 22, 2026: These terms apply to new Trace orders placed on or after this date. Terms supplied with earlier orders remain unchanged.

Trace production and delivery

Your first digital proof will be prepared within 48 hours after we receive complete, usable intake and route information. Trace production takes 8–10 business days after complete intake and written approval of the identified proof. Proof preparation, production and carrier transit are separate stages. Priority shipping does not shorten production time.

The general 1–3-business-day processing statement below does not apply to Trace. Trace launches with domestic US shipping only; worldwide shipping statements below do not apply to Trace. Trace is excluded from the general free-shipping-over-$35 offer unless a Trace-specific promotion is expressly shown at checkout. Available delivery options and charges are shown at checkout.

Report shipping damage within 7 calendar days after delivery to support@teklostudio.com, with your order number and photos of the item and packaging. This shipping-damage reporting window does not remove the remedies for defective items described in our refund policy.

Thank you for visiting Teklo Studio! We are committed to providing you with an exceptional shopping experience, including fast and reliable shipping. Please read our shipping policy carefully to understand how we handle the delivery of your orders.

1. Free Shipping

  • Eligibility: We offer free standard shipping on most orders over $35 within the United States.

  • Exclusions: Some items may not qualify for free shipping due to their size, weight, or special handling requirements. These exclusions will be clearly stated on the product page.

2. Processing Time

  • Order Processing: Non-Trace orders are processed within 1-3 business days. Custom orders or made-to-order items may require additional processing time, which will be communicated to you at the time of purchase.

  • Business Days: Our business days are Monday through Friday, excluding holidays. Orders placed on weekends or holidays will be processed on the next business day.

3. Shipping Methods

  • Standard Shipping: Typically takes 3-7 business days for delivery, depending on your location.

  • Expedited Shipping: Available at an additional cost. Delivery times for expedited shipping range from 1-3 business days, depending on the selected service.

  • International Shipping: We ship worldwide! International shipping rates and delivery times vary by destination and will be calculated at checkout.

4. Shipping Costs

  • Domestic Orders: Free shipping on most orders over $35. For orders under $35, shipping costs will be calculated at checkout based on the selected shipping method and destination.

  • International Orders: Shipping costs will be calculated at checkout. Please note that international customers are responsible for any customs duties, taxes, or additional fees imposed by their country's customs authorities.

5. Order Tracking

  • Once your order has been shipped, you will receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. You can use this number to track your package on the carrier's website.

6. Delivery Issues

  • Delayed or Lost Packages: While we strive to ensure timely delivery, unforeseen circumstances such as weather, carrier delays, or customs processing may cause delays. If your package is significantly delayed or lost, please contact us at support@teklostudio.com for assistance.

  • Incorrect Address: Please ensure that your shipping address is accurate and complete at the time of checkout. We are not responsible for packages delivered to an incorrect or incomplete address provided by the customer.

7. Damaged Items

  • If your order arrives damaged, please contact us within 7 days of receiving your package. Provide photos of the damaged item and packaging, and we will work with you to resolve the issue promptly.

8. Changes to Shipping Policy

  • We reserve the right to update or modify this shipping policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page, and the effective date will be updated accordingly.

Contact Information If you have any questions about our shipping policy, please contact us.
